title: Book Three · Chapter 53: The Last Holiday Sunday
story:
Leo's eighth letter arrives ten days after the visit.

He wrote it at the weekend, as he promised. He and his aunt reached home on Wednesday afternoon. The grandmother's food filled their table that evening.

He has not found Anna's book yet. He will look at the larger library when his aunt has time to go that way.

Ronan answers the letter the following day. He sends his eighth letter with the two street names and news from the park.

A few more weeks pass. The summer holiday is nearly over.

On the last Sunday, Ronan meets Anna outside the hall. It is a grey morning. They can finally look at the wide window without bright sun.

Lin has another family visit. Kai is with his cousins. Today there are only two notebooks on the low wall.

Ronan is glad she has time this morning.

Anna looks at the entrance floor. It is less bright, but the first step is still clear.

“It works,” she says.

Ronan looks too. “Even today.”

She opens the summer drawings. Some pages show windows. Others show doors, stairs, and people near them.

Ronan recognises one small figure beside the hall.

“Me?”

“Your shoes.”

“They are better than your door.”

“Your door,” Anna says.

He laughs and gives the notebook back.

They sit for a while. A man opens the hall doors wider. Two women go inside with a long paper roll between them.

Anna watches the roll pass through without a bend.

“I want to draw that entrance from inside,” she says.

“Today?”

“Not today. We need to ask. And I have school things to finish at home.”

“Me too.”

She closes the notebook. They agree to ask at the hall another day, after the first week of school.

At the corner, Ronan tells her about Leo's letter and the larger library.

“He doesn't need to go just for my book,” she says.

“His aunt has things to do there too.”

“Good. Tell him I found another window.”

Ronan smiles. “There may be more than one in his city.”

“Then he has work.”

They part at the crossing. Anna takes the notebook home. Ronan goes back to the green door.

Mum is measuring cloth for a customer. Dad is cleaning his work shoes. Ronan puts his own school things on the table and checks the new term sheet.

Beside his book is a clean page for Leo. He writes Anna's window question at the top, then leaves it there.

First, he needs to finish tomorrow's work.

He opens the school book and sets the dark blue pen beside it. Outside, the blue bike stands in the yard with the old bell in the last warm light.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

recognise＝认出；figure＝画里的人物形象；bend＝弯折；new term＝新学期。

## 理解问题

1. Leo有没有兑现回去后写信的约定？Ronan有没有回复？
2. 暑假结束前，Anna想进一步观察什么？两人有没有不问别人就直接进去作画？

## 读句子

**Today there are only two notebooks on the low wall.**

拆开看：Today / there are only two notebooks / on the low wall.

今天／只有两本笔记本／放在矮墙上。
